exchanges: my brother andy is getting married in august and im in charge of the banquet side. help
Happy to help. A wedding banquet is a big job, where are you at with it?
restaurant booked. golden phoenix, 30 tables
Thirty tables is a proper banquet. Have you started on the menu?
they have set menus, 9 courses. my mom is choosing bc obviously
Of course. Mothers and banquet menus go together.
lol yes. ok so seating is gonna kill me
Seating always does. Who are the tricky ones?
both grandpas for one. yeye only speaks Cantonese and waigong only speaks Mandarin so they cant even talk lol
Then each needs a table with people who share his language, or a bilingual grandchild sitting between them.
ha my cousin mei-ling can sit w them she speaks both
Perfect, she'll be the bridge.
shes also playing guzheng at the tea ceremony
Live music at the tea ceremony is beautiful. Lucky family.
chloe is so happy about that
It sounds like a lovely way to welcome her into the family.
chloe's the bride btw. her mom is flying in from Leeds, first time in asia
A big trip. She'll probably appreciate someone to guide her through the customs of the day.
her name is deborah, shes lovely, a bit overwhelmed
Understandable. A buddy for Deborah on the day would help.
my uncle ming is lending his Jaguar for the bridal car
That's a classy bridal car. Does it need decorating?
ribbons and flowers on the front yes
Classic. A florist can do a car arrangement easily.
the MC is a guy called jun, hes a radio host here
Someone from radio will keep the night moving and won't be thrown by a microphone.
and confusingly my cousin jun is also coming, hes the one who just finished med school
Two Juns, one on the mic and one off it. Easy enough to tell apart.
lion dance team is booked too, sifu lam runs it, his troupe has done like every wedding in the district
A troupe with that track record knows how to work a banquet hall.
they come in at the start for luck
That's the best way to open, with all the drums.
oops i got something wrong, uncle ming's car is a Bentley not a jaguar, the jaguar was his old one
Bentley it is. Still a grand bridal car.
lol hes very proud of it
As he should be.
red envelopes table, do we need someone watching it
Yes, it's common to have a trusted relative or two collecting and logging them at the entrance.
my aunt su-wen will do it, shes an accountant so shes perfect
Someone who counts money for a living is exactly right for that table.
games for the door ceremony too, the groomsmen have to get past the bridesmaids
The door games are always the funniest part of the morning. Do you have challenges planned?
chloe's bridesmaids are making andy eat wasabi and sing
Brave of Andy. That'll be on video for years.
also her best friend priyanka is in charge of the bridesmaids, shes a dance teacher so andy has to do a routine
Then there'll definitely be choreography. Andy should start practising.
he has no idea lol
Even better for the video.

chloe's mom is coming from leeds right
what does uncle ming do for work
should we get a photo booth or is that too much
